From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warden private infra deep-dive (VPC + air-gapped) — proposed slots

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the interest in a private deployment. To make the architecture review productive, we'd like to run a 90-minute technical deep-dive focused on VPC networking, ingress/egress controls, and the air-gapped installation path (network diagrams, package transfer, KMS/HSM expectations).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 14 Apr, 09:30–11:00
- Wed 14 Apr, 13:00–14:30
- Thu 15 Apr, 10:00–11:30

Attachments: a short checklist (RI_private-deploy-checklist.pdf) and a sample network diagram. Could you confirm which slot works and who from Warden should present (network/security/ops)? Also, please fill out the attached Warden_VPC_Config_Questions.xlsx so we can tailor the review.

If you prefer, we can include our partner AtlasCloud on the call to go over cloud connectivity options.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RI_private-deploy-checklist.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Warden_VPC_Config_Questions.xlsx (xlsx)]

Hi Naomi —

Thanks — this is exactly what we had in mind. Priya and I are available for the Wed 14 Apr 09:30–11:00 PT slot. We will also pull in our lead network engineer (internal) — I will add him to the invite once I confirm availability.

Quick note on the environment: our target is an air-gapped on-prem installation with a dedicated VPC for management traffic. We do have an internal proxy for package transfer via secure USB handoff; Priya will include details in the config spreadsheet.

Also, can you include a brief pre-read? Anything that outlines the expected host/instance sizing and required outbound ports would be super helpful.

Sanjay
Founder, Warden Tech
[Attachment: Warden_VPC_Network_Diagram.pdf (pdf)]

Perfect — locking Wed 14 Apr 09:30–11:00 PT for now.

For the pre-read, attaching a short sizing and network expectations doc (see RI_private-deploy-checklist.pdf). High-level items we'll cover in the call:
- topology and management plane isolation (VPC/subnets, NAT, private endpoints)
- package transfer and attestations for air-gapped installs
- KMS/HSM integration options and key rotation cadence
- ingress controls, egress allowlist and monitoring hooks
- quantization/instance sizing trade-offs for cost and latency

Rishi will walk through runtime implications for network-constrained environments; Marcus can speak to our private Helm bundle and air-gap delivery model.

Naomi
